venue_sync_check.note: receive-synchronized observations whose venue timestamps are far apart indicate local scheduling delay, not a real simultaneous quote

derived_cross_test.note: fraction_abs_below_after_demeaning is the informative one whenever the residual carries a persistent wedge

deterministic_census.duration_note: computed on uncensored events only; events truncated by desynchronization or end-of-sample are excluded

lead_lag.confound_note: one instrument supplies 98.6% of synchronized observations because the venue flushes it last in each burst; closed_by therefore mostly recovers that base rate. Judge lift over base rate, not raw counts, and treat Hayashi-Yoshida on raw tick times as the only unconfounded lead-lag instrument here.
lead_lag.hy_interpretation: positive best lag_ms means the majors LEAD the quoted cross by that many ms (series 2 = cross had to be shifted later to line up)
